book.name: LOMA
book.title: Loma wali Leta Pol wana Leleli

content: Komiu gegewemiu, panayawi ana tologugui wali logugui nuku henapuan. Kaiwena nige tologugui etega i mamasal bwagabwaga, yaa i neem Yehoba elana, ge tologugui bolo sauga ya hi logulogugui Yehoba i telel.
Inoke ebo gamagal etega tologugui wali logugui i pihigelgel-an, he toto Yehoba i teli heiya te i pihigelgel-an, ge henala ebo ni ginol ola o, yaka totona ana lahi i ginol to.

He nige tage bolo pagan waiwaisana hi awaawaginol tologugui nihi lovakunagil, yaa bolo pagan nanakina hi awaawaginol heliya te nihi lovakunagil. Inoke ebo nige nuwamiu tologugui nuku lovakunagil, pagan waiwaisana ana kamwasa nuku awaawaginol, inoke nihi tobalagimiu.

Kaiwena heliya Yehoba wana totuwalali hi tuwalali wami waisi kaiwena. Yaa ebo pagan nanakina nuku ginol, ali lovakun ni gan eliyamiu, kaiwena heliya wali sapu i gan bosowailiya nihi lahemiu. Heliya Yehoba wana totuwalali ge Yehoba wana lahi nihi pek bolo nak ana toginol elal.
Inoke tologugui wali logugui nuku henapuan, nige tage eba nihi lahemiu, yaa kaiwena iyaka ku atena i sapu te nuku ginol ola o.
Inoke toto o kaiwena wami takis al nuku pwamola, kaiwena tologugui heliya Yehoba wana totuwalali, wali sauga hi talamwanek logulogugui elana.
Nuku ginol paolaolaek tologugui gegewel elal: takis tomaha ge tomaha nuku pwamola elal, ge nuku awatauwagil bubun.
Bahi ami vaga ni gagan alomiyau elal. Yaa vaga maisena iyoho i mina nuku ginol, iya hiwe: nuku penunuwana-agimiu. Henala ebo alona ni nunuwana-an, iya iyaka Logugui ana nuwatu i paolaolaek.

Logugui i ba, “Bahi alom lagona nu gaganawali,” “bahi taulol,” “bahi kaoma,” ge “bahi alom wana bugul matam ni momomoni-an.” Logugui bolo ya ge logugui gegewel al ali nuwatu hi kin pamaisena logugui maisena gamwanaa, i ola hiwe: “Alom nu nunuwana-an ni ola totom u nunuwana-agiwa.”
Ebo avala ta nunuwana-an, he nige ta giginol panak eliyana. Inoke ebo avala ta nunuwana-an, yaka Logugui ana nuwatu ta paolaolaek to.

Pagan o nuku ginol, ginebi ge wami aatena sauga toto ya kaiwena. Sauga iyaka i vin ge nuku lut; bahi al nuku kekenu. He sauga valila ta abulilek telipuna, lan toto Keliso ni sikalim ge Yehoba ni pwamwalila nige i mimikelaubwa, yaa sauga ya iyaka i kelaubwa hot.
Sauga kekeisi bulin ni mowasi; lan kelaubwa ni gan. Inoke gogou paganina ta aliyoho, ge haveyan bugulina ta galoi ta ola mwananal ana tolohaveyan.

Wala minamina ta matahikan bubun ni ola kila lan mwananalina gamagaliliyau. Bahi ta nonoek yaliyaya nanakina ge loimwim elana, bahi ganawal ge pagan pulupuluwawena ta giginol, ge bahi lohalohaveyan ge lomwaketa paganina ta giginol.
Yaa Babala Yeisu Keliso nuku galoi, ge bahi nuwamiu ni nonoek tuwamiu ana nuwatu nanakil elal.
